messages:
zoe_sales: Customer on POC (acct=acct_LMN123) says their free credits dropped from 40k -> 1k overnight and they saw a bunch of 429s during a morning load test. they're asking for a root-cause before exec review. can we swarm? :grimacing:
amit_support: on it. can they paste a short client log + SDK version and confirm whether they run any retrying worker or queue?
zoe_sales: pasted log and said SDK=python v1.3.9-custom and they have a sidecar process that republishes failed events to the queue. log excerpt:
```
2026-04-02T09:03:45Z INFO send request tokens=1400 route=/v1/chat/completions
2026-04-02T09:03:47Z WARN request timed out, will retry
2026-04-02T09:03:48Z INFO republished task id=task_7f to queue
2026-04-02T09:03:50Z INFO send request tokens=2800 route=/v1/chat/completions
2026-04-02T09:03:53Z INFO success req_id=req_z12 tokens=2800
```
rachel_engineer: interesting: note the second call shows tokens=2800 (double). could be the client accidentally concatenating history when republishing (sidecar adds previous payload). need request bodies or req_id mapping. amit, can you request request headers and the exact payload before/after republish?
amit_support: asked customer for payload diffs and whether sidecar alters the prompt. also requested quick usage dump via admin endpoint: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDFW" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/internal/usage?account=acct_LMN123&start=2026-04-02T08:50:00Z&end=2026-04-02T09:20:00Z" | jq .
```
zoe_sales: customer returned SDK details: their custom wrapper concatenates conversation chunks when republishing; it effectively doubles the context on retry. also they included a screenshot showing ~39,200 consumed in that 30m window.
usage_bot: metering summary: acct_LMN123 consumed 39,200 units between 2026-04-02T08:55Z and 2026-04-02T09:15Z. anomaly detector: sudden jump in average tokens/request from 1,400 -> 2,800 at 09:03:50Z.
rachel_engineer: pulled server logs and found request pairs where both accepted and consumed tokens. example snippet: 
```
[2026-04-02T09:03:45Z] req=req_y9 status=200 tokens=1400 route=/v1/chat/completions
[2026-04-02T09:03:50Z] req=req_z12 status=200 tokens=2800 route=/v1/chat/completions
```
rachel_engineer: that indicates the retry sent a different payload (longer) which legitimately consumed more tokens, not classic duplicate identical requests. still customer didn't expect extra tokens on retry. recommend: 1) credit for unexpected consumption while they fix sidecar; 2) guidance to stop republishing original+history; 3) temporary rate/concurrency bump so their demo isn't blocked.
igor_billing: finance view: free_credit was 40,000 pre-window, post-window is ~800. billing_bot, can you prepare a provisional goodwill credit note and amount?
usage_bot: dedupe analysis: approx 20 requests where token sizes doubled; estimated excess consumption attributable to republishing behavior = ~19,600 units.
amit_support: recommended response to customer: pause the sidecar republisher, roll back to original payload, or ensure republished tasks set X-Idempotency-Key and do not append full history. provide minimal remediation steps.
zoe_sales: customer asked if we can fast-track a credit since they're demoing tomorrow. what can we offer?
igor_billing: policy: for clear accidental client-side changes that cause unexpected higher consumption, we can offer a one-time goodwill credit equal to the measured excess. I'll queue 19,600 units pending finance approval. also suggest we offer a temporary soft-spend alert lowered to 20% of free credits.
rachel_engineer: ops_note: we'll also document this edge-case in devex KB: "sidecar/republisher pitfalls" and add example of checking request payload length and using idempotency keys. I'll add a quick troubleshooting snippet and a sample payload-check script.
amit_support: ops change requested: increase concurrency for acct_LMN123 from 6 -> 18 for 12h to avoid 429 while they test. deploy_bot: change accepted: cfg_change_20260402_05, concurrency 6->18 for 12h.
igor_billing: billing_bot queued credit: acct=acct_LMN123 amount=19600 reason="unexpected increased consumption due to sidecar republishing longer payloads" status=pending_approval.
zoe_sales: customer replied: "Thanks, pausing republisher now and will run a targeted test. Appreciate the credit offer and the bump — will confirm after retest." :pray: closing unless finance needs more info.
amit_support: follow-up: we'll review incoming payloads for the next 24h to ensure no further anomalies and share logs with customer.
rachel_engineer: long-term follow-up: propose server-side advisory that warns if later requests from same requester increase token count >2x within 10s window and surface a warning in console. filing RFC.\eol
